title: Rust: airtime tracking in duty cycle
description: Airtime tracking feeds duty cycle. AC: Actual airtime deducted from duty cycle budget after TX.
close_reason: Infrastructure for airtime tracking: Added TxResult struct with airtime_us field. Changed Radio::transmit() to return Result<TxResult, Error>. Updated all 10 Radio implementations to return airtime (actual from sim, estimated for hardware). Stack integration (calling DutyCycleTracker.record_tx after TX) deferred - requires adding tracker to Stack.
